title: Vignette 2026-10-30: confidence built from relationships, not pure affirmation

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30: "The workflow system is moving towards a confidence level rather than pure affirmation. I think that is important in general.

We should be able to generally build up confidence based on the number of relationships and their strength."

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-30; recorded verbatim.
